items.title: Weekly report shows unexpected draw in crude inventories
items.summary: A weekly storage report showed crude inventories falling while analysts had expected a build, a sign of firmer domestic demand.

items.title: Producer group signals it may raise output next quarter
items.summary: Delegates of a producer group said members are discussing a gradual increase in supply, which could ease tightness in the crude market.

items.title: Pipeline operator completes routine inspection
items.summary: A pipeline operator said a routine inspection finished on schedule with no impact on flows.
